do_not_use: Do not offer 1844 as a choice, and do not call 1844 the official adoption.
Do not say France passed a national law adopting braille in 1854.
Do not say Braille invented the system at twelve or at fifteen.
Do not say Barbier invented night writing for Napoleon's soldiers, or that Dufau burned braille books.
Do not call braille a language; it is a writing system.

Representation limits: no portrait or likeness of Louis Braille; no blind child with bandaged eyes, dark glasses or pity framing; no generated braille that could be read as real text; nothing that suggests death or mourning, a year, a calendar or a congress.
